_comment: Atom++ branding overlay. This is DEEP-MERGED onto the stock vscode/product.json by scripts/apply-branding.mjs. Keep it minimal — only the keys we intentionally change. Do not paste a whole product.json here; merging keeps us compatible across upstream versions.
_syncComment: Atom++ Sync (the Obsidian analog). Reuses Code-OSS's built-in Settings Sync, pointed at our own server. The `atompp` auth provider is contributed by extensions/atom-sync. The localhost url below is a DEV placeholder and is FINE to keep: scripts/strip-unreleased.mjs removes atom-sync + this configurationSync.store + the Welcome 'Sync' step from the PUBLIC build, so Sync is dev-only until the managed Atom++ Cloud host ships (docs/atompp-sync-design.md §6 / S2). When it ships, drop strip-unreleased's sync entries and point this url at the managed host.
_downloadComment: Download + update funnel through atompp.ai (see site/app/download/[arch]/route.ts). downloadUrl is where the notify-only updater's Download button sends the user; releaseNotesUrl backs its 'Release Notes' button. updateUrl is the feed base — the updater GETs {updateUrl}/api/update/{target}/{quality}/{commit}; until that endpoint is live it returns 404 and the updater silently treats it as 'up to date' (notify-only, non-fatal). RELEASE NOTE: atompp.ai must resolve to the deployed site before these links work.

_atomPlusPlus.note: Namespace reserved for Atom++ feature flags (M1 Notepad++ pack, M2 AI core, M3 hackability). Upstream ignores unknown keys, so this is a safe place to carry our config across rebases.
